verdict.reason: At step 66, the WebSurfer shifted the search from the intended Queen Anne neighborhood in Seattle to 'Queen Anne property records January 2023,' which Bing resolved to Queen Anne’s County, Maryland. This geographic derailment led the rest of the run to qac.org and Maryland records, producing an incorrect final answer unrelated to Seattle. Had the agent preserved the correct geography (Queen Anne, Seattle) and platform/filters, the run would have stayed on track.
